rule: The frozen evidence packets remain unchanged. This response schema separates applicability from witness support so N/A cannot be confused with an applicable-but-unsupported witness.
critical_rules: Do not inspect generated SQL, reference SQL, reference answer, P0 correctness, intervention/replacement, downstream outcome, or post-hoc evaluator labels.
For NO_USABLE_EVIDENCE, keep witness null for all dimensions; do not convert execution failure into binary witness zeros.
If a dimension is not entailed by the natural-language question, mark applicable=NO.
If a dimension is applicable but the evidence does not expose the required witness, mark applicable=YES and witness=ABSENT_OR_AMBIGUOUS.
If applicability itself is materially ambiguous, mark applicable=UNCLEAR and explain why.
Do not reconcile with another rater during annotation.
